capabilities: Sync Obsidian checklist tasks to the Morgen calendar app
Time block tasks by dragging them onto the calendar
Write done dates back to Obsidian when tasks complete in Morgen
Auto-schedule next instances of recurring tasks
Hide or replace task IDs in Obsidian task lists with emoji
disambiguation: The Obsidian plugin itself adds little in-vault functionality; the scheduling happens in the external Morgen app.
extras: Morgen offers a 14-day free trial; task sync is one area under active development (mobile sync and notes-as-tasks are listed as future work).
problem: Obsidian has no way to schedule tasks onto a calendar or time block them against appointments.
summary: Time-blocking companion that syncs Obsidian checklist tasks into the Morgen calendar app for scheduling and status tracking.
